environment.tool: manual audit of the tag source + live compiled binary against a strict-token upstream peer

findings.description: The upstream target is rebuilt as the configured prefix plus path.substr(config length) plus query. The length is config text but the string is the decoded path, so a path whose decoded length equals the prefix length slices to empty and the emitted target is the destination alone. Lane config: proxy_prefix=/api on the proxied location. produces upstream GET /exec?cmd=whoami HTTP/1.1 on a single request with no percent byte in the target; the peer executes the command. Control /hello.txt returns 200 on the same config. Execution is sh -c on the upstream host.
findings.title: The slice length comes from config while the index is the decoded path, so an equal-length path emits the destination alone and reaches the exec route with zero client encoding

limitations: RCE is on the upstream host, not local
Needs a proxied location whose configured prefix the path can fully consume
